note: one layer set per emotion; `layers.face.v3` equals toon.ts EXPR_FACES[expr] (test: minecraft-presets.test.ts)

emotions.determined: working, committing to a risky move (digging, before a jump)
emotions.fear: looking at a danger before acting (on the rim, looking down into the pit)
emotions.terror: the hit: a monster appears, an arrow lands beside you
emotions.shock: close-up surprise only (face fills > 25 % of the frame height)
emotions.idea: the moment the plan clicks (the 'aha' before the payoff)
emotions.biggrin: triumph, showing off the result (the payoff line)
emotions.joy: warm happiness, a win that is not cocky
emotions.smile: calm content, the moment before a turn (smile -> fear)
emotions.angry: frustration at a mob or a failure
